title: Curvature Mismatch and Local Errors in Galaxy Property Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear probes are widely used to evaluate learned representations and infer physical quantities from unlabelled data. The probe's predictions are from an affine function in ambient space restricted to the underlying representation, and consequently, even a representation that has complete information needed to predict a target can produce systematic probe errors when that information is encoded in a form inaccessible to the linear probe. Here we share that some of this probing error is due to the innate geometry of the manifold. translated_title: 星系性质估计中的曲率失配与局部误差
translated_abstract: 线性探针被广泛用于评估学习到的表示，并从无标注数据中推断物理量。探针的预测来自于环境空间中限制在底层表示上的仿射函数，因此，即使一个表示包含了预测目标所需的全部信息，当这些信息以线性探针无法访问的形式编码时，仍可能产生系统性的探针误差。本文揭示了部分探针误差源于流形的固有几何结构。当线性探针在弯曲流形上进行评估时，通常具有非零的固有Hessian矩阵（通俗地称为“面向探针的曲率”），该曲率由⟨w_N, II⟩给出，即流形的第二基本形式与探针法向分量的点积。作者将线性探针拟合到来自五个预训练编码器的星系嵌入上，并对该曲率项进行干预，以评估其对估计误差的贡献。
tldr: 本文揭示了线性探针在弯曲流形上评估时会因流形固有曲率（第二基本形式与探针法向分量的点积）产生系统性估计误差，并通过干预实验量化了该曲率项对五个预训练编码器星系性质估计误差的贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that linear probes on curved manifolds incur systematic errors due to intrinsic manifold curvature—the second fundamental form dotted with the probe's normal component—and quantifies this curvature term's contribution to galaxy property estimation errors through interventions on embeddings from five pretrained encoders.
